states.title: States
states.description: Two-letter codes from: CA, TX, WA, VA, CO, MD, TN. Empty for all seven.

lookbackDays.title: Received in the last (days)
lookbackDays.description: Notices the state received or published within this many days.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Only notices whose company name contains one of these, e.g. Amazon, Intel, Kaiser.

noticeTypes.title: Notice types
noticeTypes.description: Closure, Layoff or Relocation. Empty for all. Texas and Tennessee do not publish the type.

onlyNew.title: Only notices not returned before
onlyNew.description: On: each run returns only notices earlier runs (with the same filters) have not. For alerts on a schedule. Off: every notice in the window.

maxNotices.title: Max notices
maxNotices.description: Stop after this many, newest first. Any cut off are returned by the next run.
